summary: Iteration 6 smoke test on fresh deployment (https://phed-deploy-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: /api/health returns ok+db connected; admin login with admin/PhedAdmin@2026 returns valid JWT (ADMIN role); wrong password returns 401; /api/auth/me + towns/dashboard-stats endpoints work with token. Frontend: landing login page loads (title 'PHED - Public Health Engineering Department'), wrong-password shows 'Invalid credentials' toast and stays on /login, correct login navigates to /admin dashboard with full sidebar (PHED Dashboard, Consumers, Surveys, Employees, Towns, MC Properties etc.) and stat cards (all showing 0 as expected on fresh DB). Token persisted in localStorage. All 6 pytest cases pass; no console-blocking errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing test_smoke.py hardcodes a stale default URL 'phed-deploy-v1' (note the -v1) which will 404 unless REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported; consider removing the default so missing env fails fast.
seed_data_creation: None. Fresh DB, only seeded admin exists (as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://phed-deploy-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Login POST /api/auth/login with {username,password} returns {token, refresh_token, user}. Frontend uses Next.js served on port 3000; login form uses placeholder-based selectors (input[placeholder*='sername'], input[type='password'], button[type='submit']). Successful login routes to /admin. When running pytest, export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first.
